item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00466","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C06","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C25 provides a highly specific drafting template: both proclamations enlarge an existing Southwestern national monument with a small adjacent tract donated by the Southwestern Monuments Association; identify historic ruins on the tract; invoke the same statutory authority; condition monument status on federal title and valid existing rights; describe the parcel by metes and bounds; and use nearly identical monument-protection warnings. C06 reproduces essentially the same Aztec Ruins text but is internally corrupted and mislabeled, making C25 the clearer source. C15 shares the acquisition-upon-title mechanism but lacks the distinctive donor-and-ruins parallel.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Southwestern Monuments Association has offered to donate to the United States, for inclusion in such monument, a tract of land adjacent thereto containing the ruins of a lime kiln","parent_excerpt":"the Southwestern Monuments Association ... has donated the said tract of land to the United States for addition to such monument","explanation":"Distinctive shared donor, adjacent-land, and monument-addition formulation."},{"child_excerpt":"it would be in the public interest to include such tract of land ... and the ruins thereon in the Tumacacori National Monument","parent_excerpt":"it would be in the public interest to reserve such tract of land as an addition[] to the said Aztec Ruins National Monument","explanation":"Parallel public-interest finding adapted to a different monument and ruin."},{"child_excerpt":"by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 2 of the act of June 8, 1906 ... subject to valid existing rights, the following-described tract of land shall, upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States, be added to, and become a part of the Tumacacori National Monument","parent_excerpt":"under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 2 of the act of June 8, 1906 ... subject to valid existing rights, the following-described tract of land in New Mexico is hereby added to and reserved as a part of the Aztec Ruins National Monument","explanation":"Substantially the same operative legal machinery for adding a specifically described tract."},{"child_excerpt":"Beginning at a point ... thence, east, 70 feet; north, 92 feet; west, 70 feet; and south, 92 feet, to the point of beginning; containing 0.15 acres, more or less","parent_excerpt":"Beginning at a point ... thence N. 00° 53' E. ... thence east 60.0 feet ... to the point of beginning, containing 1.255 acres, more or less","explanation":"Both place a compact metes-and-bounds parcel description immediately after the operative addition clause."},{"child_excerpt":"Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of this monument, and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.","parent_excerpt":"Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.","explanation":"Nearly verbatim warning clause completing the shared operative sequence."}]}
